elements.label: Out-of-focus foreground person passing out of frame left, revealing the office background

sfx_review.label: music
sfx_review.note: Tonal harmonic onset with sustained low partials, same timbre as the soft plucked music bed in e001; before the burst and with no visual hit at 5.68 s.

sfx_review.label: music
sfx_review.note: Continuing music bed note at the start of the burst; not a designed SFX for the foreground move.

pattern.description: Live-action office footage: a blurred foreground figure slides out of frame to the left, uncovering a colleague and the window behind while the in-focus subject stays put; letterbox bars stay static.
pattern.why_premium: Shooting through a shallow-focus foreground and letting it clear acts as a natural, in-camera wipe that adds depth and a cinematic reveal without any graphic transition.

build_hint.gsap: For a graphic recreation: a blurred foreground layer (filter: blur(20px)) over the scene; gsap.to(foreground, {xPercent: -60, duration: 0.3, ease: 'power2.out'}) while the scene layer stays static.
build_hint.remotion: Layer a blurred foreground / above the scene; translateX = interpolate(frame, [start, start+8], [0, -700], {easing: Easing.out(Easing.quad), extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}); scene untouched.

notes: Motion is inside the stock/live footage (camera.move none), not an applied animation; the build hint is only for a graphic recreation. b01 marks the revealed area, since the occluder itself has left frame by the end frame.
